revisions.change_summary: Description of change: Revised documentation requirements to require formal NCMR for all nonconformances; added CAPA escalation criteria for NCM trends; added documented risk assessment requirement for use-as-is dispositions; corrected form number typographic error; 21 CFR Part 820 section 820.90 citation updated to QMSR with ISO 13485 clause. Reason for change: IA-2025 mNC 15; IA-2025 OFI 8.
